home.heroTitle: Get help when it matters most.
home.heroDescription: SOS-Kamer helps you report incidents, share useful information and follow the progress of your report.
home.immediateDangerDescription: Do not wait for a report. Call the appropriate emergency service directly.
home.emergencyServicesDescription: Tap a service to open your phone dialer with the number ready.
home.phoneConfirmation: Your phone may ask you to confirm the call before dialing.
home.howItWorksTitle: Report an incident and follow what happens next.
home.howItWorksDescription: When you are not in immediate danger, SOS-Kamer gives you a simple way to report an incident and keep track of its progress.
home.reportStepDescription: Tell us what happened and provide the important details.
home.evidenceStepDescription: Share photos or video when it is safe to do so.
home.trackStepDescription: Check your report and follow its status from your account.
